statement: No qualifying genetic evidence links BACE1 to Alzheimer disease (0 evidence rows read), although the disease has genetic evidence for other targets (e.g. APP, PSEN1, PSEN2).
rule: Mendelian: ClinGen, Gene2Phenotype, Genomics England, Orphanet, UniProt literature, or ClinVar with a pathogenic variant. Mendelian, subtype: every such record is for a subtype (a more specific disease under this one in the ontology, as Open Targets returns it), none for the disease itself. GWAS: credible set with locus-to-gene score >= 0.5. Somatic: IntOGen, Cancer Gene Census. Strongest wins. 'none' needs every evidence row read and genetic data for the disease.
fact_label: Genetic support for the target–disease pair. none = the disease has genetic data, but it does not support this target; no_data = the disease has no genetic data at all; mendelian_subtype = Mendelian evidence only for a subtype (a more specific disease under it in the ontology), not for the disease itself: +1, not the +2 of Mendelian evidence
